title: Milestone: TXAM's Shenzhen & Huizhou Dual Manufacturing Bases Fully Completed with 100,000 Square Meters
contentHtml:
In March 2026, TXAM's Huizhou smart manufacturing base officially commenced full production, marking the formal establishment of the company's "Shenzhen-Huizhou dual-base 100,000 square meter smart manufacturing base" strategic structure.

Dual-Core Drive, Capacity Leap

The Huizhou base covers 60,000㎡, adopting industry-leading smart production line designs with complete assembly, testing, and packaging systems. After production begins, the company's overall capacity will more than double, with annual output value expected to reach hundreds of millions of yuan.

Serving World-Class Customers Globally

Leveraging expanded capacity and 19 years of technical expertise, TXAM is now capable of undertaking billion-yuan orders from world-class enterprises. The company will continue to deepen its focus on non-standard automation, providing higher-quality products and services to long-term partners such as TCL, Skyworth, Midea, Konka, and Changhong.

Looking ahead, TXAM will continue to advance smart manufacturing upgrades and contribute more to China's smart manufacturing.
